title: Lines from before the release keep their price and show Priced before tiers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'See Financial Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Have on staging a work order created before the release that is still open, with a part line priced by its matrix; note the line's sell price (for example $56.00).
custom_steps:
1. Open that work order.
  2. Point at the part line's sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The line shows the noted sell price ($56.00).
  • No gray Manual icon shows beside the price.

Step 2:

  • The price details read "Priced before tiers".
